messages:
Ava Chen: ok team — proposing a soft-launch for the design partner (DP) cohort next Wed. want to lock acceptance criteria & recruiting pitch.

Mike Rivera: sounds good. what's target size? 8-12?

Sophia Lee: prefer 6 active partners first week to iterate quickly. propose 2-week trial period so we can validate onboarding and feedback loops.

Jordan Park: agree on smaller. acceptance tests should be product + infra checklist. returning items we need to measure: onboarding time <1h, integration sample up in 3 calls, error rate <1%.

Ava Chen: capturing that. draft acceptance checklist:
```
- NDA signed
- onboarding doc completed (first request -> sample request)
- integration test passes (sample request -> expected response)
- latency p50 <200ms for sample workload
- telemetry events flowing and traceable to partner ID
- smoke regression run (no critical failures)
```

Emma Davis: for recruitment pitch, we should highlight early support + a dedicated SRE contact. propose incentive options: $500 stipend OR $2k Redwood credit (credit preferred for paying customers). :money_with_wings:

Mike Rivera: I'd push credits for customers (aligns incentives). stipend ok for startups or agencies. also think we should cap total credits per cohort.

Sophia Lee: feedback cadence: weekly 30m sync + async prompt/channel with pinned prompt sets. we'll tag feedback by category so PMs/ML/reliability can triage: UX, perf, quality, docs.

Jordan Park: rollout policy idea: canary 2 partners -> expand to remaining if no major infra/model blockers after 10 days. fallback plan: auto-route to hosted model variant and notify partner if degraded.

Ava Chen: success metrics to evaluate at pilot end: integration rate (% who complete onboarding), weekly active usage (calls/day), qualitative NPS from DP, number of regressions triggered by model changes, time-to-first-success (minutes).

Emma Davis: I'll draft a short recruiting script + outreach template with screening questions (use-case, expected qps, privacy constraints).

Ava Chen: action items - @Mike Rivera: draft credit vs stipend policy and budget cap (EOD). @Sophia Lee: write feedback cadence + tagging guide (Fri). @Jordan Park: define acceptance automation scripts and smoke tests (Tue). @Emma Davis: outreach template (tomorrow). I'll own the acceptance checklist and kickoff agenda.

ops-bot: Reminder set: DP soft-launch kickoff in 3 days (channel #product). :calendar:
